title: Man arrested for allegedly stabbing dog, attacking responding cop in Taguig
summary: A 34-year-old man was arrested in Taguig City after allegedly attacking a dog with a kitchen knife and assaulting a responding police officer on October 31, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said.
